steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Deadly Daggers of Daveroth
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical|, |!energy|, or |!mystic|.
If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

attacks.name: Shining Circle of the Seraphim
steps: Allied characters in |!range| of this attack do not suffer |!damage| from it.
|!wild| |*Cleanse|: After each attack is resolved, remove 1 special condition from this character and each allied character within |!range| 2 of it.
|!wild| |!block| |*Salve|: After each attack is resolved, remove 1 |!damage| from this character and each allied character within |!range| 2 of it.

superPowers.name: Scalpel of Strange
superPowers.body: Choose this character or a character within |!range| 2 and Place it within |!range| 3 of its current position. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Chosen of the Vishanti
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 2 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Eye of Agamotto
superPowers.body: This character can modify and reroll |!failure| results. When this character is attacking, defending, or dodging, it may reroll all of its dice.

superPowers.name: Mystic Armor of Strange
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!energy| or |!mystic| attack, for each |!wild| in the defense roll it may change one of the attacker's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| results to a blank. This character gains 1 |!power| for each die changed in this way.
